verdict.rationale: The SDK runs language, speech, and vision models entirely on the user's own device with no network ([runanywhere-docs-3], [runanywhere-gh-1]). The Wally CLI runs local models offline and without an account ([runanywhere-docs-6], [runanywhere-docs-14]), and hosted versus local execution is an explicit choice ([runanywhere-docs-10]). However, the larger models run only on RunAnywhere's own hardware ([runanywhere-docs-13]), and the MetalRT engine is commercial rather than open ([runanywhere-comm-10]); it also requires an M3 or later Mac, with M1/M2 falling back to llama.cpp ([runanywhere-comm-13]). Hands-on reports of the local CLI crashing or failing to install show the local path is rough ([runanywhere-comm-3], [runanywhere-comm-14]). Missing for 10: a self-hostable version of the hosted Wally Cloud endpoint, an open or self-buildable inference engine, documented server-style deployment, and independent confirmation that the local install works reliably.
